PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday AUGUST 9, 2018
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Administration of Oath to Reappointed Commissioner Ward
4. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioner Avery, Olvera, and Ward
5. Review of Agenda
6. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
7. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
8. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of July 12, 2018
Minutes
9. Public Hearings
9A. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 18-003 and Site Plan Review 17-001
Spiegel Development, Inc., Applicant
Zoning Ordinance Amendment 18-003 is a request to modify Palmdale Municipal Code (PMC) Section 17.93.030 (Personal Storage Facilities) and Site Plan Review 17-001 is a request to construct an approximately 86,000 square foot personal storage facility with an on-site caretaker/manager unit located approximately 400 feet south of Avenue R-8 on the east side of Sierra Highway.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-025 recommending City Council approval of Zoning Ordinance Amendment 18-003, approving Site Plan Review 17-001, and adopting the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program prepared for the project. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
9A
9B. Conditional Use Permit 13-025 Major Modification No. 1
T-Mobile West, LLC, Applicant
A request to construct an approximately 200 square foot equipment enclosure for an existing major telecommunications facility located at 2270 East Palmdale Boulevard.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-026 approving the request to construct an approximately 200 square foot equipment enclosure for an existing major telecommunications facility and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
9B
9C. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 18-001, Conditional Use Permit 18-002, and Site Plan Review 18-020
MMP Properties, Inc., Applicant
Zoning Ordinance Amendment 18-001 is a request to amend the Palmdale Municipal Code (PMC) to increase the maximum building height in the C-4 zone from three-stories to four-stories and allow more than four-stories through approval of a Conditional Use Permit (CUP); Conditional Use Permit 18-002 is a request to establish a hotel use; and Site Plan Review 18-020 is a request to construct an approximately 58,000 square foot four-story hotel consisting of 106 rooms with approximately 116 parking spaces to be located south of Avenue O-8, approximately 600 feet west of 10th Street West.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-027 approving the proposed hotel, recommending that the City Council approve a proposal to amend the Palmdale Municipal Code to increase the allowable building height in the C-4 zone, and find that the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration for the previously approved project and the addendum prepared for this project fully addresses the proposed development. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
9C
9D. General Plan Amendment 18-004, Zone Change 18-004, Conditional Use Permit 15-036 Major Modification No. 1, and Site Plan Review 18-021
Bouma USA, Applicant
A request to expand the Palmdale Aerospace Academy to accommodate a private charter elementary school on three vacant parcels located south of Palmdale Boulevard and immediately west of the existing Palmdale Aerospace Academy high school campus.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-028 recommending City Council approval of General Plan Amendment 18-004 and Zone Change 18-004; and approving Conditional Use Permit 15-036 Major Modification No. 1 and Site Plan Review 18-021, find that the project includes minor alterations to the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration for the previously approved project, CUP 15-036, as outlined within the Addendum, and find that the two legislative acts are exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
9D
9E. Specific Plan Amendment 18-001
City of Palmdale, Applicant
Amend the Antelope Valley Auto Center Specific Plan to reflect a broader, citywide effort towards the installation of water-efficient desert landscaping and modify the sign standards for the Auto Center as requested by the auto dealers.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2018-030 recommending that the City Council approve SPA 18-001 in its entirety and find that the project is exempt from environmental review. Perry Banner, Contract Planner
9E
10. Staff Communications
10A. Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10B. Planning Commissioner Training
Noel Doran, Assistant City Attorney
